svg.title: penfield: dial a setting, get the state you need
svg.desc: Clients such as Zed's agent, fascicle flows, and curl send a request naming model auto, or a real model id. penfield, one service with one settings file, runs a ladder cheapest rung first: explicit, alias, shape, rule, then embedding and classifier in later stages, then default, stopping at the first rung that answers with confidence. Placement picks a resident, healthy, free model, and the request is forwarded to a node (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, or MLX) as it came, with only model rewritten. When the answer is Claude, penfield returns a decision and your own client runs it on your own login; penfield holds no credential. The /decisions log records every request, its rung, and why. On the line, penfield sits underneath, routing the model calls the agents make.
